race.comment: COPENHAGEN CAT (4) is the one to beat after putting together back-to-back BM58 wins, first making all at Casino on soft ground and then beating Purosangue by three lengths at Lismore. The rise to BM66 is the obvious new test, but her current-season form and strong record with Siabh Rigley give her the strongest winning profile. BELLARATA (3) is the main danger after consecutive thirds, including a brave placing at this track in BM58 grade when favourite, and she gets weight relief while remaining well suited on soft ground. LOFTY MACSPORRAN (5) resumes off two trials and has the Grafton third from last campaign to keep him in the mix, though his final run before the break was only fair. JEWELS STATEMENT (1) finished off strongly when beaten 1.1 lengths last time at Port Macquarie. Worth including again.
